caption: A close-up shows a clear plastic bottle filled with pink liquid that glows under red light, its surface covered with condensation droplets. A hand grips the bottle at the lower left, holding it above a dark tabletop while the neck intermittently enters and leaves the top edge. The bottle slowly turns about its vertical axis, and a dark label with white markings comes into view on the right side. As it turns, the label drifts toward the lower front, and the bottle's shoulder line tilts slightly with the motion. The background contains metal-framed chairs, a seated person in gray trousers, a draped blue garment, and a black backpack. Small camera and hand movement shifts the bottle and background slightly within the frame. A small purple cap-like object becomes visible at the bottom-right edge partway through the segment.
relations: Hand gripping lower left supports bottle above dark tabletop as it rotates about vertical axis.
Bottle rotation brings dark label with white markings into view on right side, drifting toward lower front.
Neck intermittently enters and leaves top edge as bottle tilts and shifts with hand movement.
Small purple cap-like object emerges at bottom-right edge partway through segment.
